# OKF frontmatter and generated marker

Every generated page includes YAML frontmatter with fields type, title, slug, repo, compile_run, commit, optionally sources, and a generated: true flag, followed by a machine warning comment indicating the file is generated.

Produce OKF-conformant Markdown that is both human-readable and agent-readable and clearly marked as generated to discourage manual edits.
